content.body:
1. I guess it depends what the future plans with XML are. I think leaving it as just TrustedParserOptions is probably fine, but not strong either way.

2. I agree they seem largely pointless but also it's already there on the existing interfaces and I don't think it matters too much. Nic opened an issue around making them immutable in some way.
Can you comment in https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10378 ?
cannot trust because someone can mangle the prototypes?
I also don't mind removing the API for now. It's easier to add it later than to remove it
Perhaps `TrustedHTMLParserOptions` is more explicit about it currently not supporting XML... I don't mind changing it
